articles.summary: Daily sales increased 15.5% year-over-year, primarily driven by share gains with larger customers, pricing actions, and broad-based demand across core end markets. Operating margin was 21.5%, a 90 basis point improvement year-over-year , as selling, general, and administrative expense leverage more than offset customer mix-related gross margin pressure. Operating cash flow was $422 million, representing 105% of net income , reflecting the timing of working capital changes associated with strong sales growth. Returned $328 million to shareholders through dividends and share repurchases, representing 82% of net income. Continued progress on strategic initiatives , including increased sales effectiveness through key account wins, expansion of digital technologies, and deeper penetration through new customer site growth.
